enabled.name: Token animations
enabled.hint: Turn on token movement animations for everyone. When off, tokens move as in plain Foundry.

calm.name: Calm effects
calm.hint: Less dust and fewer sharp motions, no screen shake. Only for you.

noShake.name: No screen shake or flashes
noShake.hint: Turns off screen shake and flashes; other animations stay. Only for you.

footprints.name: Footprints
footprints.hint: Footprints on the ground while walking. Only for you.
